messages.subject: interviewing R users/programmers at UW to inform new software development
messages.subject_clean: interviewing R users/programmers at UW to inform new software development
messages.body_plain:
Greetings,

The UW-Madison Center for High Throughput Computing <http://chtc.cs.wisc.edu> (CHTC) and the Open Science Grid <https://www.opensciencegrid.org/bin/view> (OSG) are in the early stages of developing a software package for R, and to inform this product, we are looking for R programmers of all skill levels to interview on Thursday, August 8 (next week). Please contact me (below) if you may be interested, and spread to the word to other R users. These 30-45 minute interviews will be conducted in the Wisconsin Institutes for Discovery, so we are focusing on interviewing UW-affiliated individuals who work on campus, but that's not a "rule" by any means.

'Take this opportunity to inform an academically-developed and open-source product! Those who contribute their time will have the opportunity to use/test the software at various stages before it is released.

Best Wishes,
Lauren Michael

----------------------------------------
Lauren A. Michael
Research Computing Facilitator
Advanced Computing Infrastructure <http://aci.wisc.edu/>,
Center for High Throughput Computing <http://chtc.cs.wisc.edu/>, and
Wisconsin Institute for Discovery - Core Computational Technology <http://wid.wisc.edu/research/cct/>

University of Wisconsin-Madison
330 N Orchard St
Madison, WI 53715
(608)316-4430
